voice.caption: The crew hears Charybdis roar and sees spray rising from the whirlpool.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Row, friends — we have been in worse and lived, and this too we shall remember. Helmsman, hold her off that smoke and hug the cliff — keep to the rock, or you kill us all.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus arms himself despite Circe's warning and searches the rock face.

voice.speaker: six-seized-sailors-1
voice.caption: Scylla's six heads strike, lifting six screaming men from the ship.
The survivors pass beyond both monsters while watching their companions die above them.
